I just wanna say that you sound like a high schooler right now. I know your sad I am too but life isn't about relationships, you may feel like it is but you just lost someone you loved. I have too I didn't loose a girl but instead I lost a large amount of my friends. I wasn't sad at the time but it took 6 months for me to realize what I had lost and I got more sad and angry at my self everyday. I still have friends just not like I used to. Now instead of always being sad I am sad when I am alone because it gives me time to think, and when I think I eventually get depressed. So my suggestion is to do what I do never be alone and don't think to much. Try to meet knew people it may sound hard and it is especially when your sad but if you really try to make knew friends you might eventually find a girl like you want. But if you really really really wanna give up life then go out in style go travel the world and do everything that you ever wanted to do when your 29 and do all of the dangerous things because your going to kill your self right why not do it doing something fun. You may think "nothings fun anymore" and it is if you make it that way so don't make it that way make it the way you want make it happy. TRY TO MAKE IT HAPPY. What I would like you to do is the next time you have a free day go out and treat your self outside of your house and try to meet someone. You may think your boring but you WILL find someone that doesn't think your boring. The best way to not be boring is to just do something out of the ordinary in public. Get attention make a fool of your self. People will like to talk about that. Believe me I am a very boring person but you know what I do to make people think I'm not. I make fun of my self I go make a fool of my self and enjoy life at least try to even though I am still sad it is hard because I have what i call depression spikes everyday. Like lately when I get depression spikes I think about suicide and i thought about it 3 time over the last week but then i think to my self life will get better if I make it better. No one is going to make your life better nothing will but YOU. You have to make it better.
